Your attack with Masendan scores a Critical Hit on a roll of 19 or 20.
If you expend 2 Ki Points or fewer when using Masendan, you can use it as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} instead of an {@variantrule Action|XPHB}.

items.name: Kamehameha
entries: As an {@variantrule Action|XPHB}, you can expend up to 5 Ki Points to concentrate your Ki into a single point. and unleash a powerful, streaming beam of energy. The wave travels up to 30 feet in a line that is 5 feet wide.

Each creature in the line must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes Force damage equal to your Ki Damage multiplied by the number of Ki Points expended. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage.

{@b Charged Kamehameha.} When you use Kamehameha, you can choose to charge the attack instead of releasing it. If you do so, expend the Ki Points as normal, but you don't release the energy this turn.

On your next turn, you must use your {@variantrule Action|XPHB} to release the charged Kamehameha. When released, the streaming beam of energy travels up to 60 feet in a line that is 10 feet wide, and the number of Ki Points you expended is treated as 2 higher when calculating the attack's damage.

While charging Kamehameha, you must maintain Concentration as if concentrating on a spell. If you don't release the charged Kamehameha on your next turn or lose Concentration before releasing it, the gathered energy dissipates and the Ki Points expended are lost.

subclassFeature.name: Super Saiyan
entries: {@i 6th-level Hybrid Saiyan feature}

Ancient legends tell of a Saiyan warrior who could transcend the limits of their mortal body and awaken a power far beyond that of an ordinary Saiyan. When pushed beyond their limits by overwhelming adversity, a Saiyan may awaken this power, causing their hair to turn golden and their aura to blaze with radiant energy.
To awaken Super Saiyan, you must meet all of the following requirements:
• Your Strength and Constitution scores must each be 16 or higher.
• You must have earned a total of at least 250 Zenkai over the course of your adventures. Zenkai you have spent still counts toward this total.
• During a hostile encounter, a creature you consider an ally must die within your line of sight.

After awakening Super Saiyan, you can expend 2 Ki Points to transform into a Super Saiyan without using an {@variantrule Action|XPHB} or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. While transformed, you gain the following benefits:
• While transformed, you are always under the effects of Flight and Power Full Strike without expending Ki Points.
• You have Advantage on attack rolls.
• Your Ki Damage increases by one die.
• Your Speed increases by 10 feet.
• You have Advantage on Strength and Constitution saving throws.
• You have Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing, and Force damage.

subclassFeature.name: Adaptation Ki Art II
entries: {@i 6th-level Hybrid Saiyan feature}

Your mixed heritage allows you to adapt your Ki into versatile techniques that seamlessly blend with your fighting style. These techniques favor speed, flexibility, and unexpected bursts of power over overwhelming force.

items.name: Full Power Masenko
entries: You gather an immense amount of Ki above your head, causing brilliant yellow energy to flare between your hands before bringing them forward and unleashing a vastly more powerful Masenko.
You can now expend up to 7 Ki Points when using Masenko, and its range increases to 60 feet, the number of Ki Points you expended is treated as 1 higher.
If you expend 3 Ki Points or fewer when using Masenko, you can use it as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} instead of an {@variantrule Action|XPHB}.

items.name: Super Explosive Wave
entries: You release a sudden burst of Ki from your entire body, creating a powerful shock wave that blasts away nearby enemies.

As a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} when a creature you can see within 10 feet of you hits you with an attack, you can expend up to 5 Ki Points to release an explosive wave of Ki. Each creature of your choice within 10 feet of you must make a Strength saving throw against your Ki save DC.

On a failed save, a creature takes Force damage equal to your Ki Damage multiplied by the number of Ki Points expended and is pushed 10 feet away from you. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and isn't pushed.

items.name: Super Kamehameha
entries: Your mastery of the Kamehameha allows you to channel far greater amounts of Ki into the technique. You can now expend up to 7 Ki Points when using Kamehameha. and its normal range increases to 40 feet.
In addition, when you use Charged Kamehameha, its range increases to 80 feet, the number of Ki Points you expended is treated as 3 higher when calculating the attack's damage, instead of 2 higher.

subclassFeature.name: Super Saiyan 2
entries: {@i 10th-level Hybrid Saiyan feature}

You are a Saiyan who has pushed the power of the Super Saiyan beyond its limits, awakening a form of even greater ferocity and destructive power. Your golden aura erupts with crackling lightning, your golden hair rises sharply, and your power intensifies to a terrifying degree.
To awaken Super Saiyan 2, you must meet all of the following requirements:
• You must have unlocked Super Saiyan.
• Your Strength and Constitution scores must each be 18 or higher.
• You must have earned a total of at least 500 Zenkai over the course of your adventures. Zenkai you have spent still counts toward this total.
• During a hostile encounter, you and at least two of your allies must become Bloodied or be reduced to 0 hit points.
You can expend 4 Ki Point to transform into a Super Saiyan 2 without using an {@variantrule Action|XPHB} or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. While transformed, you gain the following benefits:
• While transformed, you are always under the effects of Flight and Power Full Strike without expending Ki Points.
• You have Advantage on attack rolls.
• Your Ki Damage increases by two die.
• Your Speed increases by 20 feet.
• You have Advantage on Strength and Constitution saving throws.
• You have Resistance to Bludgeoning, Cold, Force, Lightning, Piercing, Slashing, and Thunder damage.

subclassFeature.name: Adaptation Ki Art III
entries: {@i 10th-level Hybrid Saiyan feature}

Your mixed heritage allows you to adapt your Ki into versatile techniques that seamlessly blend with your fighting style. These techniques favor speed, flexibility, and unexpected bursts of power over overwhelming force.

items.name: Spirit Ball
entries: You concentrate Ki into your hand and form it into a dense sphere of energy that remains under your control after being released, allowing you to redirect it toward your target.

As an {@variantrule Action|XPHB}, you can expend up to 10 Ki Points to create a Spirit Ball and launch it at one creature you can see within 120 feet of yourself. Make a Ki attack roll against the target. On a hit, the target takes Force damage equal to your Ki Damage multiplied by the number of Ki Points expended .
The number of Ki Points you expended is treated as 2 higher when calculating the attack's damage
Your attack with Spirit Ball scores a Critical Hit on a roll of 18, 19 or 20.

If the attack misses, the Spirit Ball remains under your control until the end of your next turn. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on your next turn, you can redirect the Spirit Ball toward the same creature or another creature you can see within 120 feet of yourself and repeat the attack without expending additional Ki Points. After this attack hits or misses, the Spirit Ball dissipates.
If you expend 5 Ki Points or fewer when using Spirit Ball, you can use it as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} instead of an {@variantrule Action|XPHB}.
This attack ignores Resistance to Force damage.

items.name: Explosive Demon Impact
entries: The an {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can expend 7 Ki Points to surge toward one creature you can see within a distance up to your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks. You must end this movement within 5 feet of the target.
Make two {@variantrule Unarmed Strikes|XPHB} against the target. These attacks must be kicks.
If both attacks hit, you can push the target up to 30 feet away from you.
This attack ignores Resistance to Force damage.

items.name: Electric Kamehameha
entries: You channel an incredible amount of Ki through your body, causing your golden aura to flash violently as you gather the energy into a brilliant golden-yellow Kamehameha. When released, the flashing energy surges forward with tremendous destructive force, creating an enormous explosion in its wake. You can now expend up to 10 Ki Points when using Kamehameha, and its normal range increases to 50 feet.
In addition, when you use Charged Kamehameha, its range increases to 100 feet, the number of Ki Points you expended is treated as 4 higher when calculating the attack's damage, instead of 3 higher.
This attack ignores Resistance to Force damage.

subclassFeature.name: Ultimate
entries: {@i 14th-level Hybrid Saiyan feature}
You have awakened the full extent of your dormant potential, allowing you to naturally wield tremendous power without placing immense strain on your body.
To awaken Ultimate, you must meet all of the following requirements:
• You must have unlocked Super Saiyan 2.
• Your Strength and Constitution scores must each be 20 or higher.
• You must have earned a total of at least 1000 Zenkai over the course of your adventures. Zenkai you have spent still counts toward this total.
{@b Ultimate Potential Ritual.} To fully unlock your potential, you must undergo a 24-hour ritual performed by a creature with the Spellcasting feature that can cast spells as Rituals.
After completing the Ultimate Potential Ritual, you gain the following benefits:
• You have Advantage on attack rolls. and your attacks score a Critical Hit on a roll of 19 or 20.
• The bonus to your Ki Damage from Unlock Potential increases from one die to two dice.
• The bonus to your Speed from Unlock Potential increases from 10 feet to 40 feet.
• The bonus to your Ki Point maximum from Unlock Potential increases from an amount equal to your Proficiency Bonus to twice your Proficiency Bonus.
• You have Advantage on Strength and Constitution saving throws.
• You have Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing, and Force damage.

subclassFeature.name: Ultimate Ki Art
entries: {@i 14th-level Hybrid Saiyan feature}

Your mixed heritage allows you to adapt your Ki into versatile techniques that seamlessly blend with your fighting style. These techniques favor speed, flexibility, and unexpected bursts of power over overwhelming force.

items.name: Hyper Masenko
entries: You gather an overwhelming amount of Ki above your head, causing brilliant yellow energy to erupt between your hands before bringing them forward and unleashing a raging, vastly more powerful Masenko.

You can now expend up to 12 Ki Points when using Masenko, and its range increases to 90 feet. For the purpose of calculating its damage, treat the number of Ki Points expended as 3 higher when calculating the attack's damage, instead of 1 higher.
If you expend 6 Ki Points or fewer when using Masenko, you can use it as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} instead of an {@variantrule Action|XPHB}.
This attack ignores Resistance to Force damage, and Immunity to Force damage is treated as Resistance against this attack.

items.name: Hyper Explosive Demon Wave
entries: Your mastery of Super Explosive Wave allows you to release a far greater burst of Ki, dramatically increasing its destructive power and range.
When you use Explosive Wave, you can expend up to 7 Ki Points instead of 5.
For the purpose of determining the damage of Explosive Wave, the number of Ki Points you expend is treated as 1 higher.
The range of Explosive Wave increases to 20 feet, and a creature that fails its saving throw is pushed up to 20 feet away from you instead of 10 feet.
This attack ignores Resistance to Force damage, and Immunity to Force damage is treated as Resistance against this attack.
If this damage reduces a creature to 0 Hit Points, its body is reduced to ash.

items.name: Ultimate Kamehameha
entries: You gather an immense amount of Ki into your cupped hands, concentrating it into a brilliant blue mass of energy before thrusting your arms forward and unleashing an enormous Kamehameha. With sufficient mastery, you can gather this tremendous power while standing perfectly still, only drawing your hands back at the final moment before releasing the devastating energy wave. You can now expend up to 12 Ki Points when using Kamehameha, and its normal range increases to 60 feet.

In addition, when you use Charged Kamehameha, its range increases to 120 feet, no longer requires Concentration and the number of Ki Points you expended is treated as 5 higher when calculating the attack's damage, instead of 4 higher.

You no longer need to use your {@variantrule Action|XPHB} on your next turn to release it. Instead, you can release the charged Kamehameha at the start of your next turn without using an {@variantrule Action|XPHB} or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.
This attack ignores Resistance to Force damage, and Immunity to Force damage is treated as Resistance against this attack.

subclassFeature.name: Mastered Ultimate
entries: {@i 18th-level Hybrid Saiyan feature}

Through relentless training and battle, you have mastered your Ultimate power, allowing you to draw upon your full potential naturally and without relying on Super Saiyan transformations. Your power now flows with complete control and efficiency, bringing your Ultimate state to its absolute peak.
To unlock Mastered Ultimate, you must meet all of the following requirements:
• You must have unlocked Ultimate.
• Your Strength and Constitution scores must each be 24 or higher.
• You must have earned a total of at least 2500 Zenkai over the course of your adventures. Zenkai you have spent still counts toward this total.
• You must win a hostile encounter against a creature whose Challenge Rating is equal to or greater than your Saiyan level without transforming into Super Saiyan or any of its advanced forms.
After mastering Ultimate, you gain the following benefits:
• You have Advantage on attack rolls, and your attacks score a Critical Hit on a roll of 18, 19, or 20.
• The bonus to your Ki Damage from Ultimate increases from two dice to three dice.
• The bonus to your Speed from Ultimate increases from 40 feet to 70 feet.
• You can take two {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on each of your turns.
• You have Advantage on Strength and Constitution saving throws.
• You have Resistance to all damage except Necrotic, Psychic, and Radiant damage.

subclassFeature.name: Advanced Ultimate Ki Art
entries: {@i 18th-level Hybrid Saiyan feature}

Your mixed heritage allows you to adapt your Ki into versatile techniques that seamlessly blend with your fighting style. These techniques favor speed, flexibility, and unexpected bursts of power over overwhelming force.

items.name: Ultimate Masenko
entries: You gather an overwhelming amount of Ki above your head, compressing it into an intensely radiant mass of golden-yellow energy before thrusting your hands forward and unleashing the ultimate form of Masenko as a colossal beam of destructive power.

You can now expend up to 15 Ki Points when using Masenko, and its range increases to 120 feet, the number of Ki Points you expended is treated as 4 higher when calculating the attack's damage, instead of 3 higher.
If you expend 7 Ki Points or fewer when using Masenko, you can use it as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} instead of an {@variantrule Action|XPHB}.
This attack ignores Resistance and Immunity to Force damage.

items.name: Thunder Bullet
entries: As an {@variantrule Action|XPHB}, you can expend up to 15 Ki Points to charges a tiny energy sphere before firing at one creature you can see within 90 feet of yourself.
Make a Ki attack roll against the target. On a hit, the target takes Force damage equal to your Ki Damage multiplied by the number of Ki Points expended.
The number of Ki Points you expended is treated as 4 higher when calculating the attack's damage
Your attack with Thunder Bullet scores a Critical Hit on a roll of 17, 18, 19, or 20.
If you expend 7 Ki Points or fewer when using Thunder Bullet, you can use it as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} instead of an {@variantrule Action|XPHB}.
This attack ignores Resistance and Immunity to Force damage.

items.name: Ultimate Explosive Kamehameha
entries: You concentrate an overwhelming amount of Ki into a brilliant blue Kamehameha, compressing tremendous power between your hands before releasing it as a colossal wave of energy. With sufficient mastery, the technique requires almost no preparation, allowing you to remain perfectly still until the final moment before unleashing its full power in a devastating surge. You can now expend up to 15 Ki Points when using Kamehameha, and its normal range increases to 90 feet in a line that is 10 feet wide.
This attack ignores Resistance and Immunity to Force damage.

In addition, when you use Charged Kamehameha, its range increases to 180 feet in a line that is 15 feet wide, no longer requires Concentration and the number of Ki Points you expended is treated as 6 higher when calculating the attack's damage, instead of 5 higher.

You no longer need to use your {@variantrule Action|XPHB} on your next turn to release it. Instead, you can release the charged Kamehameha at the start of your next turn without using an {@variantrule Action|XPHB} or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Beast
entries: {@i 20th-level Hybrid Saiyan feature}

Beast is the ultimate evolution of your awakened potential, born from the power that has continued to grow within you throughout your life. When overwhelming emotion finally pushes that potential beyond its limits, your Ultimate power erupts into a new transformation of tremendous raw power and speed, surpassing everything you were previously capable of.
To unlock Beast, you must meet all of the following requirements:
• You must have unlocked Mastered Ultimate.
• Your Strength and Constitution scores must each be 30 or higher.
• You must have earned a total of at least 5000 Zenkai over the course of your adventures. Zenkai you have spent still counts toward this total.
• During a hostile encounter, you must see a creature you consider a loved one or family member be reduced to 0 Hit Points or die.
You can expend 12 Ki Point to transform into a Beast without using an {@variantrule Action|XPHB} or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. While transformed, you gain the following benefits:
• While transformed, you are always under the effects of Flight and Power Full Strike without expending Ki Points.
• You have Advantage on attack rolls, and your attacks score a Critical Hit on a roll of 15-20.
• Your Ki Damage increases by three dies.
• Your Speed increases by 120 feet.
• You have Advantage all saving throws.
• You have Resistance to all damage.
• Whenever you take damage, reduce the damage taken by an amount equal to your Constitution modifier.

• When a creature you can see misses you with an attack, you can immediately move up to half your Speed toward that creature without provoking Opportunity Attacks and make one melee weapon attack or one Unarmed Strike against it.

• When an attack roll would hit you, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to dodge the attack, causing it to miss you instead. You can then immediately take one additional {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, which must be used to make an attack against the attacking creature or use a Ki Art that targets it.

• Once on each of your turns when you score a Critical Hit, you regain 1 expended Ki Point and can immediately use one of your Ki Arts that normally requires a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} without using a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Beast Ki Art
entries: {@i 20th-level Hybrid Saiyan feature}
You can use these Beast Ki Art only while transformed into Beast.

items.name: Special Beam Cannon
entries: As an {@variantrule Action|XPHB}, you can expend any Ki Points to concentrate an immense amount of Ki at your forehead before extending your fingers and unleashing a devastating beam of spiraling energy.

The beam travels up to 300 feet in a line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in the line must make a Dexterity saving throw against your Ki save DC. On a failed save, a creature takes Force damage equal to your Ki Damage multiplied by the number of Ki Points expended. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage.
The number of Ki Points you expended is treated as 10 higher when calculating the attack's damage
If you expend 10 Ki Points or fewer when using Beast Special Beam Cannon, you can use it as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} instead of an {@variantrule Action|XPHB}.
This attack ignores Resistance and Immunity to Force damage.

items.name: Purple Lightning Beast Kick
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can expend 10 Ki Points to surge toward one creature you can see within a distance up to your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks. You must end this movement within 5 feet of the target.

You leap forward and deliver a sudden kick to the target. This {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} automatically hits and is a Critical Hit, the target takes additional Force damage equal to your Ki Damage multiplied by the number of Ki Points expended.

When the kick hits, you can push the target up to 60 feet away from you. If the target collides with a wall, another obstacle, or another creature during this movement, the target and the creature it collides with each take Force damage equal to your Ki Damage.
This attack ignores Resistance and Immunity to Force damage.

classFeature.name: Saiyan Racial
entries: You are a Saiyan, an alien warrior race with tremendous physical potential. When you choose this class, you don't choose a separate race for your character — the traits below replace your race entirely.

entries.name: Creature Type
entries: You are a Humanoid (Saiyan).

entries.name: Age
entries: Saiyans stay in their physical prime much longer than humans to maintain their combat strength, maintaining a youthful appearance until about age 80 before aging rapidly. Their natural total lifespan is roughly similar to a human.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Saiyans tend to share common personality traits, even at young ages. Being aggressively militant, they share an innate enjoyment for conflict and fighting. Saiyans are typically very aggressive and hard-headed, with short explosive tempers. Saiyans appear inclined to be arrogant at times, They are typically chaotic natured.

entries.name: Size
entries: Saiyans are Medium or Small, your choice.

entries.name: Saiyan Speed
entries: Saiyans possess tremendous levels of superhuman speed, easily capable of breaking the sound barrier, even with their basic moves. They also have much faster reflexes than an average human
Your base walking speed is 50 feet.

entries.name: Saiyan Strength
entries: Your Strength and Constitution scores each increase by 2, to a maximum of 30. Additionally

entries.name: Saiyan Endurance
entries: Saiyans possess enormous amounts of superhuman durability and are a remarkably resilient species who refuse to be physically broken.
While you aren't wearing armor or wielding a {@item shield|xphb}, your base {@variantrule Armor Class|xphb} equals 10 plus your Strength and Constitution modifiers.

entries.name: Saiyan Power
entries: Saiyans naturally possess vast superhuman strength, far greater than that of Earthlings and other alien races and are veritable fighting machines. They are capable of easily lifting ten times their own weight.
You count as two sizes larger than your actual size when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.
Your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} deals 1d10 bludgeoning damage instead of the normal damage.

entries.name: Ki Sensing
entries: Saiyans instinctively sense the ki around them. You gain Blindsight out to a range of 30 feet.

entries.name: Tail
entries: All pure-blooded Saiyans are born with a brown-furred, monkey-like tail. The tail is prehensile and can grasp and hold objects weighing up to one-tenth of your carrying capacity, though it can't wield weapons or perform tasks requiring fine manipulation.

As long as you still have your tail, gazing directly upon a full moon triggers an uncontrollable transformation. At the start of your turn, if you can see a full moon and haven't averted your eyes or otherwise avoided its light, you transform into a Great Ape, using the statistics of the {@creature Giant Ape|MM |}.

While transformed, you retain your personality, alignment, and mental ability scores, but you lose the ability to speak, cast spells, or take any action other than Attack, Dash, or Grapple. On each of your turns, you must move toward the creature nearest to you and attack it, friend or foe alike, to the best of your ability.

The transformation ends immediately if your tail is severed, if the moon sets, or if the moon is blocked from your view for the duration of a full turn. When the transformation ends, you revert to your normal form, and your tail (if still attached) is unharmed.

entries.name: Heat Resistance
entries: Your Saiyan biology grants you exceptional resistance to extreme heat. You are unaffected by the effects of extreme heat, and you have Resistance to Fire damage.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write Common and know Common Sign.

classFeature.name: Zenkai
entries: Every 10 minute, you regain a number of Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus if you have at least 1 Hit Point. While you are in combat, this power awakens, and you instead regain twice that amount at the start of each of your turns.

Whenever you regain Hit Points after taking damage from a hostile creature in combat, you gain a number of Zenkai Points equal to the number of Hit Points regained. You can expend Zenkai Points to increase one of your ability scores by 1, at a cost equal to 10 times the new score.
In addition, you can spend Zenkai Points to permanently increase your Ki Damage by one die. The cost equals 1,000 Zenkai Points multiplied by the number of Ki Damage dice you currently have.

classFeature.name: Ki Points
entries: Saiyans have a natural affinity to control ki energy, allowing them to generate very powerful energy blasts
You have a number of ki points, as shown in the Ki Points column of the Saiyan table. You regain all expended ki points when you finish a short or long rest.
Starting at 1st level, you can use these points to fuel various ki features. You start knowing none of these features; you gain them as you reach higher levels in this class.
Your Ki save DC equals 8 + your Proficiency Bonus + your Strength modifier.
Your Ki attack modifier equals your Proficiency Bonus + your Strength modifier.

classFeature.name: Ki Arts I
entries: You can manipulate your Ki to create a variety of energy-based techniques, using your natural Saiyan affinity and martial arts mastery to enhance your combat abilities.

items: {@b Power Full Strike.} At the start of your turn, you can expend 1 Ki Point to empower your body with Ki. Until the start of your next turn, whenever you hit with an melee attack or {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, the attack deals additional force damage equal to your Ki Damage.
{@b Flight.} As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can expend 1 Ki Point to gain a Fly Speed equal to your walking speed for 10 minute.

{@b Ki Transfer.} As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can expend 1 Ki Point to transfer your Ki to another creature you can see within 30 feet of you. Until the start of your next turn, whenever the target hits with a melee attack or {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, the attack deals additional force damage equal to your Ki Damage.
{@b Ki Charged.} As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you focus your energy and begin gathering Ki. You regain a number of Ki Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

entries: You can use Ki Charged a number of times equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

classFeature.name: Telepathy
entries: You know the {@spell Message|XPHB} cantrip. In addition, you can cast the {@spell Detect Thoughts|XPHB} spell without expending a spell slot by touching the head of a creature. You can use this feature once, and you regain the ability to do so when you finish a Long Rest.

classFeature.name: Saiyan Blood
entries: At 1st level, you choose a Saiyan Blood, detailed at the end of this class description. Your choice grants you features at 1st level and again at 3rd, 6th, 10th, 14th, 18th and 20th level.

classFeature.name: Ki Arts II
entries: You learn to shape your Ki into powerful blasts and defensive barriers, allowing you to attack from a distance and protect yourself from harm.

items: {@b Ki Wave. } As an {@variantrule Action|XPHB}, you can expend a number of Ki Points up to 1 +  your Proficiency Bonus, to fire waves of ki in a straight line. The waves travel up to 30 feet in a line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in the line must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes Force damage equal to your Ki Damage multiplied by the number of Ki Points expended. On a successful save, a creature takes no damage.

{@b Ki Blast. } As an {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can expend a number of Ki Points up to 1 +  your Proficiency Bonus, to fire concentrated blasts of Ki. For each Ki Point expended, You fire one blast at a creature within 60 feet of you. Each blast deals Force damage equal to your Ki Damage on a hit.

{@b Ki Shield. } As a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} when you take damage, you can expend 2 Ki Point to surround yourself with a barrier of Ki. The damage you take is reduced by half, and you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Ki Damage.

classFeature.name: Kaio-ken
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can push your body beyond its limits, causing your aura to flare crimson. The transformation lasts for 1 minute. While transformed, you gain the following benefits:
• You can take one additional attack on each of your turns.
• Your Speed is doubled.
• Your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} deal additional force damage equal to your Constitution modifier.
When the transformation ends, your body suffers extreme recoil. You become Incapacitated for 1 round and take damage equal to half your current Hit Points.
You can use this feature once, and you regain the ability to do so when you finish a Long Rest.

classFeature.name: Saiyan Blood Feature
entries: At 3rd level, you gain a feature granted by your Saiyan Blood.

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: You gain the {@feat Ability Score Improvement|XPHB} feat or another {@feat feat|XPHB} of your choice for which you qualify.

classFeature.name: Kaio-ken x2
entries: At 5th level, your Kaio-ken reaches ×2. While transformed, you can make two additional attacks whenever you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action on your turn, and your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} deal additional force damage equal to twice your Constitution modifier.

classFeature.name: Ki Recovery
entries: Your Saiyan body has developed the ability to rapidly restore its Ki.
At the end of each of your turns, you regain 1 Ki Point. At 10th level, you instead regain 2 Ki Points. At 15th level, you instead regain 3 Ki Points. At 20th level, you instead regain 4 Ki Points.

classFeature.name: Saiyan Blood Feature
entries: At 6th level, you gain a feature granted by your Saiyan Blood.

classFeature.name: Saiyan Instinct
entries: Your Saiyan instincts sharpen your awareness, allowing you to react to danger before combat begins.
You have Advantage on Initiative rolls and add your Proficiency Bonus to those rolls. In addition, you can't be Surprised while you are conscious.

classFeature.name: Saiyan Fortitude
entries: Your Saiyan body can withstand forces that would overwhelm ordinary creatures. When you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half as much damage on a successful save, you can make a Constitution saving throw instead.
On a successful save, you take no damage from the effect. On a failed save, you take half damage instead.

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: You gain the {@feat Ability Score Improvement|XPHB} feat or another {@feat feat|XPHB} of your choice for which you qualify.

classFeature.name: Saiyan Spirit
entries: If you fail a saving throw, you can reroll it with a bonus equal to your Saiyan level. You must use the new roll, and you can't use this feature again until you finish a Long Rest.
You can use this feature twice before a Long Rest starting at level 13 and three times before a Long Rest starting at level 17.

classFeature.name: Saiyan Blood Feature
entries: At 10th level, you gain a feature granted by your Saiyan Blood.

classFeature.name: Kaio-ken x10
entries: At 11th level, your Kaio-ken reaches ×10. While transformed, you can make three additional attacks whenever you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action on your turn, and your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} deal additional force damage equal to three time your Constitution modifier.

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: You gain the {@feat Ability Score Improvement|XPHB} feat or another {@feat feat|XPHB} of your choice for which you qualify.

classFeature.name: Saiyan Resilience
entries: Your Saiyan body has developed extraordinary resilience through countless battles.
Whenever you take damage, reduce the damage by an amount equal to your Constitution modifier + your Strength modifier.
In addition, the Hit Points you regain from your Saiyan Blood are doubled.

classFeature.name: Saiyan Blood Feature
entries: At 14th level, you gain a feature granted by your Saiyan Blood.

classFeature.name: KI Mastery
entries: You have perfect ki control. The Ki Point cost to transform and maintain a Saiyan Transformation is reduced by half, rounded down.
While you have the Bloodied condition, this feature does not activate.

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: You gain the {@feat Ability Score Improvement|XPHB} feat or another {@feat feat|XPHB} of your choice for which you qualify.

classFeature.name: Kaio-ken x20
entries: At 17th level, your Kaio-ken reaches ×20. While transformed, you can make four additional attacks whenever you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action on your turn, and your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} deal additional force damage equal to four time your Constitution modifier.

classFeature.name: Saiyan Blood Feature
entries: At 18th level, you gain a feature granted by your Saiyan Blood.

classFeature.name: Epic Boon
entries: You gain an {@feat Epic Boon|XPHB} or another {@feat feat|XPHB} of your choice for which you qualify.

classFeature.name: Limit Break
entries: Each of your ability scores increases by 2.
Your ability scores no longer have a maximum.

classFeature.name: Saiyan Blood Feature
entries: At 20th level, you gain a feature granted by your Saiyan Blood.

entries.name: Miraculous Recovery
entries: As a bonus action, you can eat this bean to regain all your hit points and all expended Hit Dice. You also end the blinded, deafened, paralyzed, and poisoned conditions affecting you, and remove one level of exhaustion.

Eating the bean restores your physical stamina and grants you the benefits of finishing a short rest, without requiring you to spend any time resting. You regain any class features or other abilities that normally recharge when you finish a short rest.
The bean does not restore expended spell slots or abilities that recharge only when you finish a long rest. It cannot restore missing body parts, cure diseases, end curses, or revive a dead creature.

entries.name: Lasting Sustenance
entries: Eating a single Senzu Bean provides enough nourishment to sustain a creature for 10 days. For that duration, the creature does not need to eat or drink, and it suffers no adverse effects from ordinary hunger or thirst. The bean does not eliminate the need for sleep.

entries.name: Cultivation
entries: A Senzu Bean can be planted in fertile soil. It requires water, sunlight, and suitable growing conditions to thrive. After 30 days, the plant produces 1d4 Senzu Beans. A harvested Senzu Bean retains all its magical properties. The plant continues producing beans every 30 days as long as it remains healthy.
A creature planting a Senzu Bean must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom or Nature check to cultivate it successfully. On a failure, the planted bean is destroyed.

entries.name: Implant Dragon-like Heart
entries: The heart must be implanted through a surgical procedure performed by a skilled medical practitioner. No magical ritual is required.

At the conclusion of the procedure, you must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the implantation fails and the heart is destroyed. On a successful save, the heart is permanently implanted within your body, granting you attunement to it.

A creature can have only one dragon heart implanted within its body at a time. A new dragon heart can be implanted to replace an existing one, but the previously implanted heart is destroyed in the process. Once implanted, a dragon heart cannot be removed by any means short of a {@spell wish} spell.

entries.name: Damage Absorption
entries: Whenever you take damage of the damage type associated with your dragon-like heart, reduce that damage by an amount equal to your proficiency bonus.

entries.name: Dragon Breath (Recharge 5-6)
entries: As an action, you exhale elemental energy in either a 15-foot cone or a 30-foot line that is 5 feet wide (your choice). Each creature in that cone or line must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking a number of d4s equal to your primary ability modifier in elemental damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The element of the dragon's heart determines the damage type of the exhalation.

entries.name: Elemental of the Dragon
entries: Once per round, when you cast a spell or use an ability that deals damage of your attuned damage type, you deal extra damage equal to a number of d4s equal to your primary ability modifier.

entries.name: Dragon Scale
entries: Your scales harden, granting you a natural armor class of 14. In addition, your unarmed strikes deal 1d4 slashing damage.

entries.name: Implant Wyrmling Heart Ritual
entries: To obtain a wyrmling heart capable of undergoing this ritual, the heart must first be carefully extracted intact from the body of a wyrmling dragon. The extraction must be performed without damaging the heart in any way.

Once obtained, the wyrmling heart must be enchanted through a ritual performed by a willing spellcaster who possesses knowledge of the ritual. The ritual takes 4 hours to perform and must be completed in its entirety.

At the conclusion of the ritual, you must make a DC 16 Wisdom or Charisma saving throw (your choice). On a failed save, the ritual fails and the wyrmling heart is destroyed. On a successful save, the wyrmling heart becomes enchanted and is permanently implanted within your body, granting you attunement to the heart.

A creature can have only one dragon heart implanted within its body at a time. A new dragon heart can be implanted to replace an existing one, but the previously implanted heart is destroyed in the process. Once implanted, a dragon heart cannot be removed by any means short of a {@spell wish} spell.

entries.name: Damage Absorption
entries: You have resistance against the heart's damage type.

entries.name: Dragon Breath (Recharge 5-6)
entries: As an action, you exhale elemental energy in either a 30-foot cone or a 60-foot line that is 5 feet wide (your choice). Each creature in that cone or line must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking a number of d6s equal to your primary ability modifier in elemental damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The element of the dragon's heart determines the damage type of the exhalation.

entries.name: Elemental of the Dragon
entries: Twice per round, when you cast a spell or use an ability that deals damage of your attuned damage type, you deal extra damage equal to a number of d6s equal to your primary ability modifier.

entries.name: Dragon Scale
entries: Your scales harden, granting you a natural armor class of 16. In addition, your unarmed strikes deal 1d6 slashing damage.

entries.name: Dragon Sense
entries: You have blindsight out to a range of 10 feet.

entries.name: Dragon Wings
entries: You can fly at half your walking speed.

entries.name: Implant Dragon Heart Ritual
entries: To obtain a dragon heart capable of undergoing this ritual, the heart must first be carefully extracted intact from the body of a dragon. The extraction must be performed without damaging the heart in any way.

Once obtained, the ancient dragon heart must be enchanted through a ritual performed by a willing dragon or another creature with equivalent knowledge and expertise in the ritual. The ritual takes 1 day to perform and must be completed in its entirety.

A creature can have only one dragon heart implanted within its body at a time. A new dragon heart can be implanted to replace an existing one, but the previously implanted heart is destroyed in the process. Once implanted, a dragon heart cannot be removed by any means short of a {@spell wish} spell.

entries.name: Damage Absorption
entries: You have immunity to the damage type associated with your dragon heart.

entries.name: Dragon Breath (Recharge 5-6)
entries: As an action, you exhale elemental energy in either a 60-foot cone or a 120-foot line that is 10 feet wide (your choice). Each creature in that cone or line must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking a number of d8s equal to your primary ability modifier in elemental damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The element of the dragon's heart determines the damage type of the exhalation.

entries.name: Elemental of the Dragon
entries: A number of times per round equal to your proficiency bonus, when you cast a spell or use an ability that deals damage of your attuned damage type, you deal extra damage equal to a number of d8s equal to your primary ability modifier.

entries.name: Dragon Scale
entries: Your scales harden, granting you a base AC of 18. In addition, your unarmed strikes deal 1d8 slashing damage.

entries.name: Dragon Sense
entries: You have blindsight out to a range of 30 feet and truesight out to a range of 10 feet.

entries.name: Dragon Wings
entries: You can fly at a speed equal to your walking speed.

entries.name: Draconic Lifeforce
entries: You age at a slower rate. For every 10 years that pass, your body ages only 1 year, and you are immune to being magically aged.

entries.name: Dragon Heart Ritual
entries: To obtain a dragon heart capable of undergoing this ritual, the heart must first be carefully extracted intact from the body of an ancient dragon. The extraction must be performed without damaging the heart in any way.

Once obtained, the ancient dragon heart must be enchanted through a ritual performed by a willing ancient dragon who possesses knowledge of the ritual. The ritual takes 1 day to perform and must be completed in its entirety.

At the conclusion of the ritual, you must make a DC 20 Wisdom or Charisma saving throw (your choice). On a failed save, the ritual fails and the dragon heart is destroyed. On a successful save, the dragon heart becomes enchanted and is permanently implanted within your body, granting you attunement to the heart.

A creature can have only one dragon heart implanted within its body at a time. A new dragon heart can be implanted to replace an existing one, but the previously implanted heart is destroyed in the process. Once implanted, a dragon heart cannot be removed by any means short of a {@spell wish} spell.

entries.name: Damage Absorption
entries: You have immunity to the damage type associated with your dragon heart. Whenever you are subjected to damage of that type, you take none of that damage and regain a number of hit points equal to half the damage dealt.

entries.name: Dragon Breath (Recharge 5-6)
entries: As an action, you exhale elemental energy in either a 90-foot cone or a 180-foot line that is 10 feet wide (your choice). Each creature in that cone or line must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking a number of d10s equal to your primary ability modifier in elemental damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The element of the dragon's heart determines the damage type of the exhalation.

entries.name: Elemental of the Dragon
entries: When you cast a spell or use an ability that deals damage of your attuned damage type, you deal an extra d10s damage equal to your primary ability modifier.

entries.name: Dragon Scale
entries: Your scales harden, granting you a natural armor class of 20. In addition, your unarmed strikes deal 1d10 slashing damage.

entries.name: Draconic Lifeforce
entries: You age at a slower rate. For every 10 years that pass, your body ages only 1 year, and you are immune to being magically aged.

entries.name: Dragon Sense
entries: You have blindsight out to a range of 120 feet and truesight out to a range of 30 feet.

entries.name: Dragon Wings
entries: You can fly at a speed equal to twice your walking speed.

entries.name: Legendary Resistance (1/Day)
entries: If you fail a saving throw, you can choose to succeed instead.

entries.name: Great Wyrm Heart Ritual
entries: To obtain a Great Wyrm heart capable of undergoing this ritual, the heart must first be carefully extracted intact from the body of a Great Wyrm. The extraction must be performed without damaging the heart in any way.

Once obtained, the Great Wyrm heart must be enchanted through a ritual performed by a willing Great Wyrm or another creature with equivalent knowledge and expertise in the ritual. The ritual takes 7 days to perform and must be completed in its entirety.

At the conclusion of the ritual, you must make a DC 24 Wisdom or Charisma saving throw (your choice). On a failed save, the ritual fails and the Great Wyrm heart is destroyed. On a successful save, the Great Wyrm heart becomes enchanted and is permanently implanted within your body, granting you attunement to the heart.

A creature can have only one dragon heart implanted within its body at a time. A new dragon heart can be implanted to replace an existing one, but the previously implanted heart is destroyed in the process. Once implanted, a dragon heart cannot be removed by any means short of a {@spell wish} spell.

entries.name: Damage Absorption
entries: You have immunity to the damage type associated with your Great Wyrm heart. Whenever you are subjected to damage of that type, you take none of that damage and regain hit points equal to the amount of damage prevented.

entries.name: Dragon Breath (Recharge 5-6)
entries: As an action, you exhale elemental energy in either a 120-foot cone or a 240-foot line that is 15 feet wide (your choice). Each creature in that cone or line must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking a number of d12s equal to your primary ability modifier in elemental damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The element of the Great Wyrm heart determines the damage type of the exhalation.

entries.name: Elemental of the Dragon
entries: When you cast a spell or use an ability that deals damage of your attuned damage type, you deal extra damage equal to a number of d12s equal to your primary ability modifier.

entries.name: Dragon Scale
entries: Your scales harden, granting you a base AC of 24. In addition, your unarmed strikes deal 1d12 slashing damage.

entries.name: Draconic Lifeforce
entries: You age at a slower rate. For every 10 years that pass, your body ages only 1 year, and you are immune to being magically aged.

entries.name: Dragon Sense
entries: You have blindsight out to a range of 240 feet and truesight out to a range of 120 feet.

entries.name: Dragon Wings
entries: You can fly at a speed equal to three times your walking speed.

entries.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If you fail a saving throw, you can choose to succeed instead. You can use this property three times per day.

entries.name: Great Wyrm's Arcane Legacy
entries: When you finish a long rest, choose one spell from the Sorcerer spell list of any level. The chosen spell is stored within your Great Wyrm heart and does not count against your number of spells known.
You can cast the stored spell once without expending a spell slot. Once you cast the spell in this way, you cannot do so again until you finish a long rest.
Whenever you finish a long rest, you can choose a different spell from the Sorcerer spell list to replace the stored spell.
If the stored spell can be cast at a higher level, it is always cast as a 9th-level spell when cast using this feature, regardless of its normal level.

Your primary ability modifier is used for the spellcasting ability of spells cast through this feature. Your spell save DC equals 8 + your proficiency bonus + your primary ability modifier, and your spell attack bonus equals your proficiency bonus + your primary ability modifier.

item.name: Hashirama Cells
entries: These cultivated cells originate from Hashirama Senju, the legendary shinobi whose vitality and Wood Release were beyond ordinary human limits. Implanting them into a creature's body grants extraordinary regenerative power, but the cells may overwhelm an incompatible host.

entries.name: Cells Implantation
entries: When these cells are implanted, you must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or suffer rejection. On a failure, you take 6d10 necrotic damage, gain 1d4 levels of exhaustion, and the cells die, losing all their properties. The dead cells cannot be revived or restored. To gain the benefits of Hashirama Cells, you must obtain a new viable sample and undergo the implantation procedure again.

entries.name: Cellular Regeneration
entries: At the start of each of your turns during combat, if you have at least 1 hit point, you regain hit points equal to your character level + your Constitution modifier (minimum of 1 hit point).
Outside of combat, if you have at least 1 hit point, you regain hit points equal to your Constitution modifier every 10 minutes.
If you have 0 hit points but are not dead, your cells continue to regenerate. You regain to 1 hit points in 1 minutes. This regeneration stops if you die.

entries.name: Cellular Vitality
entries: Your Constitution scores each increase by 4, to a maximum of 30.

In addition, your hit point maximum increases by an amount equal to twice your character level when you receive these cells. Whenever you gain a level, your hit point maximum increases by an additional 2 hit points.

entries.name: Undying Cell
entries: Your body is exceptionally resilient against death. You gain expertise in death saving throws, meaning you add twice your proficiency bonus to death saving throws.
In addition, You have Advantage on the death saving throws

entries.name: Wood Release
entries: The power of Hashirama's cells grants you the ability to cast certain spells. You learn the spells listed below when you reach the specified character level. You can cast each spell once without expending a spell slot, and you regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest. You do not need material components when casting these spells through this trait.

items: Character level 1: {@spell Druidcraft}
Character level 2: {@spell Goodberry}
Character level 3: {@spell Spike Growth}
Character level 5: {@spell Plant Growth}
Character level 7: {@spell Grasping Vine}
Character level 9: {@spell Tree Stride}
Character level 11: {@spell Wall of Thorns}
Character level 13: {@spell Regenerate}
Character level 15: {@spell Clone}
Character level 17: {@spell Imprisonment}

entries.name: Rinnegan Awakening
entries: If Hashirama Cells are implanted into a creature that possesses a Sharingan or has Uchiha lineage, the creature must make one death saving throw against a DC of 20.
On a successful death saving throw, the creature's Sharingan immediately evolves into a Rinnegan, replacing the Sharingan and granting all properties of the Rinnegan.
On a failed death saving throw, the Sharingan does not evolve. The creature can attempt this death saving throw again whenever it gains a level.
At 20th level, this death saving throw automatically succeeds, causing the Sharingan to immediately evolve into a Rinnegan.

item.name: Sharingan
entries: The Sharingan is a powerful ocular ability belonging to the Uchiha bloodline. Its abilities develop through combat and significant experiences, allowing the wielder to awaken increasingly powerful stages of the eye.

entries.name: Sharingan Implantation
entries: When these eyes are implanted, you must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or suffer rejection. On a failed save, you take 6d6 necrotic damage, gain 1d4 levels of exhaustion, and the implanted eyes have their Durability reduced to 0, becoming blind and losing all their properties. An eye with 0 Durability cannot be revived or restored. To gain the benefits of the Sharingan, you must obtain a new viable sample and undergo the implantation procedure again.

entries.name: Sharingan Ability Modifier
entries: Constitution is the primary ability score for all ocular abilities. You use your Constitution modifier, proficiency bonus, and combined Eye Mastery Bonus to determine the attack bonus and saving throw DC of your ocular abilities, including abilities granted by advanced evolutions of the Sharingan.

entries.name: Eye Mastery Bonus
entries: Each eligible awakened eye grants an Eye Mastery Bonus based on its evolution stage. Add the bonuses from your left and right eyes together, even if they have different evolution stages.

entries.name: Ocular Attack Bonus
entries: When an ocular ability requires an attack roll, use the following modifier:
Ocular Attack Bonus = your proficiency bonus + your Constitution modifier + your total Eye Mastery Bonus

entries.name: Ocular Save DC
entries: When an ocular ability requires a saving throw, use the following DC:
Ocular Save DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Constitution modifier + your total Eye Mastery Bonus

entries.name: Ocular Limit
entries: A creature can benefit from the Eye Mastery Bonus of no more than two eyes at a time. Only eyes installed in the creature's natural eye sockets, consisting of the left and right eye, can grant this bonus.
Additional eyes implanted elsewhere on the body, such as on the arms, forehead, palms, or chest, do not grant an Eye Mastery Bonus.
If a creature possesses more than two eligible eyes, it must choose which two eyes grant its Eye Mastery Bonus. This choice cannot be changed during combat.
Eyes that do not grant an Eye Mastery Bonus may still retain other properties and abilities granted by their respective items, unless otherwise specified.

entries.name: One-Tomoe Sharingan
entries: Your Sharingan awakens in its initial form, granting you the following benefits:

items: You gain darkvision out to a range of 60 feet. If you already have darkvision, its range increases by 30 feet instead.
You have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.
You can discern fine visual details and follow subtle movements with supernatural precision. You have advantage on the first attack roll you make against a creature during each of your turns.

entries: Your Sharingan evolves when you experience significant events during combat. It can advance directly to a higher stage without awakening the previous stages, depending on the event that occurs.
When you defeat a hostile creature while at least one allied creature you can see is bloodied, your Sharingan advances to the Two-Tomoe Sharingan.

entries.name: Ninjutsu Copy
entries: Your ocular abilities allow you to observe, analyze, and memorize spells cast by other creatures. When you can see a creature casting a spell within your line of sight, you can memorize that spell without using an action or reaction.
You can memorize spells of levels 1 through the maximum spell level determined by your ocular evolution. Cantrips cannot be copied.

You can memorize a number of spells equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum of one spell). If you attempt to memorize a spell while at your maximum capacity, you must forget one previously memorized spell before memorizing the new one.
You can cast a memorized spell without expending a spell slot. You can cast only one copied spell at a time. Once you cast a copied spell, it is removed from your memorized spells.

When you witness a creature casting a spell, you can choose to cast that spell immediately or memorize it for later use. If you choose to cast it immediately, you must cast the spell you are currently observing. You cannot immediately cast a spell that you previously memorized.

You use your Ocular Attack Bonus and Ocular Save DC whenever a copied spell requires a spell attack roll or saving throw. You must still provide any required components and meet the spell's other requirements.

entries.caption: Copy Spell
rows: Once per Short or Long Rest
Once per Short or Long Rest, or once per Initiative for each battle

entries: When you have multiple eyes with different ocular evolutions, use the highest evolution among your eligible eyes to determine your maximum spell level and usage frequency. Possessing multiple eyes does not grant additional uses.

entries.name: Taijutsu Copy
entries: Your Sharingan allows you to observe, analyze, and replicate the physical features and abilities of other creatures. When you can see a creature within your line of sight, you can attempt to copy one of its features.

entries.name: Copy Features
entries: Your ocular abilities allow you to observe, analyze, and memorize features used by other creatures. When you can see a creature use a feature within your line of sight, you can attempt to copy and memorize that feature without using an action or reaction.

When attempting to copy a creature's feature, you must make a Constitution saving throw. The DC equals the creature's Challenge Rating (CR). If the creature has no Challenge Rating, use its character level instead.
If your Constitution modifier plus your Ocular Evolution Bonus is equal to or greater than the target's CR or character level, you automatically succeed without making a saving throw.

Otherwise, make a Constitution saving throw against a DC equal to the target's CR or character level. Add your Ocular Evolution Bonus to the roll. You succeed if the total equals or exceeds the target's CR or character level.
Your Ocular Evolution Bonus to Constitution saving throws made to copy features is determined by your highest ocular evolution.

On a successful saving throw, you successfully analyze and memorize the chosen feature. On a failed saving throw, the attempt fails and you cannot copy that feature from the same creature again until you finish a long rest.

You can memorize a number of copied features equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum of one feature). If you attempt to memorize a feature while at maximum capacity, you must forget one previously memorized feature before memorizing the new one.
You can use a memorized feature as if it were your own, following its original rules and requirements, unless otherwise specified.

entries.name: Copy Limitations
entries: Physical Copy can reproduce techniques and abilities that are learned, trained, or developed through practice. This includes class features, feats, combat maneuvers, martial techniques, weapon techniques, and similar physical or learned abilities.

Physical Copy cannot reproduce racial or species traits, bloodline abilities, Kekkei Genkai, innate supernatural abilities, unique biological features, special organs, or abilities that depend on a creature's natural physiology.

A copied feature must be something that can reasonably be performed by the user's own body and abilities. The DM determines whether a feature qualifies as a learned or physical technique and can be copied.
Features that directly grant or manipulate spells are copied through Copy Spell instead of Physical Copy.
Copying a feature does not grant proficiency, expertise, ability score increases, racial traits, or other prerequisites required to use that feature.

Your body can retain and reproduce a number of copied techniques equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum of one technique). This limit represents how many foreign techniques your body can comprehend, adapt to, and physically reproduce at the same time.
If you are already at your maximum capacity, you must forget one memorized technique before you can memorize a new one.
Forgetting a copied technique removes your ability to use that technique until you copy it again.

entries.name: Two-Tomoe Sharingan
entries: Your Sharingan develops a second tomoe, improving your ability to perceive and predict movement.
You retain the benefits of the One-Tomoe Sharingan and gain the following additional benefits:
You have advantage on initiative rolls.
You have advantage on saving throws against being charmed or against spells and other effects that create illusions.
When an allied creature you can see is reduced to 0 hit points, your Sharingan advances to the Three-Tomoe Sharingan.

entries.name: Genjutsu
entries: You can attempt to deceive the senses of a creature you can see by expending 5 Sharingan Energy and reducing the Sharingan Durability of the eye used by 1. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw against your feature save DC.
If the target can see you, it makes this saving throw with disadvantage.

On a failed save, you impose an illusion upon the target for 1 minute. The illusion can alter what the target sees, hears, or otherwise perceives, but it cannot directly control the target's actions or force it to harm itself.
While affected, the target treats the illusion as real unless it succeeds on an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your feature save DC or is otherwise given a reason to doubt its senses.
If you use this ability against a creature during combat, the target can repeat the Wisdom saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

entries.name: Three-Tomoe Sharingan
entries: Your Sharingan reaches its fully developed form, granting you exceptional perception and the ability to anticipate your opponents' movements.
You retain the benefits of the One-Tomoe and Two-Tomoe Sharingan.
You can cast {@spell suggestion} without expending a spell slot. Once you cast the spell in this way, you can't do so again until you finish a short or long rest.

When a creature you can see makes its first attack roll against you during each round of combat, that attack roll has disadvantage. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a short or long rest.
When an allied creature you can see dies, your Sharingan advances to the Mangekyō Sharingan.

entries.name: Tailed Beast Genjutsu
entries: You can expend 10 Sharingan Energy to attempt to control a creature of the Beast or Monstrosity type that you can see. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw against your feature save DC. On a failed save, the target must obey your commands while the genjutsu remains active.
Whenever you take damage, the affected creature can repeat the Wisdom saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.
The genjutsu ends if your Sharingan Energy is depleted.

entries.name: Mangekyō Sharingan Awakening
entries: When your Sharingan evolves into the Mangekyō Sharingan, roll 1d4 on the following table to determine the abilities awakened in your left and right eyes.

item.name: Mangekyō Sharingan
entries: The Mangekyō Sharingan is an advanced form of the Sharingan, granting its wielder powerful ocular abilities at the cost of the eyes' durability. Its powers include enhanced perception, powerful genjutsu, reality-altering techniques, and Susanoo.

entries.name: Mangekyō Sharingan Implantation
entries: When these eyes are implanted, you must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or suffer rejection. On a failed save, you take 6d8 necrotic damage, gain 1d4 levels of exhaustion, and the implanted eyes have their Durability reduced to 0, becoming blind and losing all their properties. An eye with 0 Durability cannot be revived or restored. To gain the benefits of the Mangekyō Sharingan, you must obtain a new viable sample and undergo the implantation procedure again.

entries.name: Sharingan Energy and Durability
entries: Your left and right eyes each have a maximum Sharingan Durability equal to 10 times your Constitution modifier (minimum of 1).
Your maximum Sharingan Energy is equal to half the sum of your left and right maximum Sharingan Durability, rounded down.
When you finish a short rest, you regain Sharingan Energy equal to 20 percent of your maximum Sharingan Energy, rounded down.
When you finish a long rest, you regain Sharingan Energy equal to your maximum Sharingan Energy.

Whenever an ability reduces your Sharingan Durability, reduce the Durability of the eye used to activate that ability. If an ability specifically states that it reduces the Durability of both eyes, reduce the Durability of both your left and right eyes by the specified amount.

Your Sharingan Durability can't be restored by resting or other ordinary means. Once either eye's Sharingan Durability is depleted, that eye must be replaced with another Mangekyō Sharingan eye through transplantation.

entries.name: Enhanced Sharingan
entries: You can discern fine visual details and follow subtle movements with supernatural precision. You gain the following benefits:
You gain all benefits of the Sharingan
You gain darkvision out to a range of 120 feet. If you already have darkvision, its range increases by 60 feet instead.
You have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.
You have advantage on the first attack roll you make against a creature during each of your turns.
You have advantage on initiative rolls.
You have advantage on saving throws against being charmed and against spells and other effects that create illusions.
You can cast {@spell suggestion} without expending a spell slot once per short rest.
When a creature you can see makes its first attack roll against you during each round of combat, that attack roll has disadvantage.

entries.name: Enhanced Visual Perception
entries: At the start of your turn, you can expend 3 Sharingan Energy and reduce the Sharingan Durability of both your left and right eyes by 1 to heighten your visual perception until the start of your next turn. For the duration, you have advantage on all attack rolls you make and all saving throws you make, and attack rolls against you have disadvantage.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a short or long rest.

entries.name: Advanced Genjutsu
entries: You can attempt to manipulate the senses of a creature you can see by expending 5 Sharingan Energy and reducing the Sharingan Durability of the eye used by 1. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw against your feature save DC.
If the target can see you, it makes this saving throw with disadvantage.
On a failed save, you can alter the target's perception of reality for 8 hours. You can make the target perceive creatures, objects, sounds, or surroundings differently from how they actually are.

The target perceives the illusion as reality and acts according to what it believes it is experiencing. The illusion can cause the target to mistake an ally for an enemy, an enemy for an ally, or otherwise misinterpret its surroundings.
The illusion cannot directly control the target's body or force it to perform an action. The target chooses its own actions based on what it perceives.
While affected, the target treats the illusion as real unless it succeeds on an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your feature save DC or is otherwise given a reason to doubt its senses.
If you use this ability against a creature during combat, the target can repeat the Wisdom saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

entries.name: Izanagi
entries: As a reaction, you can use Izanagi to alter the outcome of an event affecting yourself, treating an unfavorable outcome as an illusion and rewriting reality in your favor.

After using Izanagi, the eye used to activate this ability becomes permanently blind, and its Sharingan Durability is reduced to 0. This blindness can't be removed by resting or ordinary healing. The eye must be replaced through transplantation to restore vision.

entries.name: Izanami
entries: As a reaction, you can use Izanami to trap a creature in a repeating sequence of events, forcing it to experience a loop until it accepts the truth underlying the illusion.

After using Izanami, the eye used to activate this ability becomes permanently blind, and its Sharingan Durability is reduced to 0. This blindness can't be removed by resting or ordinary healing. The eye must be replaced through transplantation to restore vision.

entries.name: Susanoo
entries: Susanoo is a powerful manifestation of the user's chakra, forming a towering spiritual warrior around their body. As the user's mastery of the Sharingan grows, Susanoo can develop from a skeletal form into increasingly powerful forms, providing immense protection and supernatural strength.
You must have awakened the Mangekyō Sharingan in both eyes before you can manifest Susanoo.

entries.name: Bone Susanoo
entries: You can activate Bone Susanoo at any time by expending 10 Sharingan Energy. You don't need to pay the maintenance cost on the turn you activate it. Starting at the beginning of your next turn, you can expend 5 Sharingan Energy to maintain it.
When you activate this Susanoo, you gain temporary hit points equal to 10 times your Constitution modifier.
While this Susanoo is active, you gain the following benefits:

items: You gain a +2 bonus to AC.
You gain a +1 bonus to all saving throws.
You gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls.
The save DC of your features and spells increases by 1.
At the start of each of your turns while this Susanoo is active, you gain temporary hit points equal to 5 times your Constitution modifier, replacing any temporary hit points you currently have.

entries: You can end Bone Susanoo at any time, requiring no action. If you can't pay the Sharingan Energy cost to maintain it, the form ends automatically.

entries.name: Skeletal Susanoo
entries: You can activate Skeletal Susanoo at any time by expending 20 Sharingan Energy. You don't need to pay the maintenance cost on the turn you activate it. Starting at the beginning of your next turn, you can expend 10 Sharingan Energy to maintain it.
When you activate this Susanoo, you gain temporary hit points equal to 20 times your Constitution modifier.
While this Susanoo is active, you gain the following benefits:

items: You gain a +5 bonus to AC.
You gain a +2 bonus to all saving throws.
You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls.
The save DC of your features and spells increases by 2.
At the start of each of your turns while this Susanoo is active, you gain temporary hit points equal to 10 times your Constitution modifier, replacing any temporary hit points you currently have.

entries: You can end Skeletal Susanoo at any time, requiring no action. If you can't pay the Sharingan Energy cost to maintain it, the form ends automatically.

entries.name: Humanoid Susanoo
entries: You can activate Humanoid Susanoo at any time by expending 30 Sharingan Energy. You don't need to pay the maintenance cost on the turn you activate it. Starting at the beginning of your next turn, you can expend 15 Sharingan Energy to maintain it.
When you transform into Humanoid Susanoo, you gain temporary hit points equal to 30 times your Constitution modifier.
While this Susanoo is active, you gain the following benefits:

items: You gain a +10 bonus to AC.
You gain a +5 bonus to all saving throws.
You gain a +3 bonus to attack rolls.
The save DC of your features and spells increases by 3.
At the start of each of your turns while this Susanoo is active, you gain temporary hit points equal to 15 times your Constitution modifier, replacing any temporary hit points you currently have.

entries: You can end Humanoid Susanoo at any time, requiring no action. When you end Humanoid Susanoo, you revert to Skeletal Susanoo if you can still maintain it; otherwise, Susanoo ends. If you can't pay the Sharingan Energy cost to maintain Armored Susanoo, the form ends automatically.

entries.name: Susanoo Signature Weapons
entries: Your Susanoo's signature weapon determines the number of attacks you can make with it as part of an action: Skeletal allows 1 attack, Humanoid allows 2 attacks, Armoured allows 3 attacks, and Complete allows 4 attacks.
Bone Susanoo does not have a signature weapon and can only make attacks with Chakra Sword. On a hit, the attack deals additional d8s force damage equal to your Constitution modifier.

items: Totsuka Blade. As an action, you can make an attack with the Totsuka Blade. On a hit, the attack deals additional d10s fire damage equal to your Constitution modifier. If the target has 10 percent or less of its hit point maximum remaining, it dies instantly. A creature killed by the Totsuka Blade is sealed within the gourd and cannot leave the seal or be restored to life by any means.
Yata Mirror. As a reaction, you can manifest the Yata Mirror to defend against an attack, causing the attack to deal no damage to you and preventing any effects of the attack from affecting you.
Yasaka Magatama. As a bonus action, you can manifest and throw Yasaka Magatama. On a hit, the attack deals additional d8s fire damage equal to your Constitution modifier.

Flame Chakra Sword. As an action, you can make an attack with the Flame Chakra Sword. On a hit, the attack deals additional d10s fire damage equal to your Constitution modifier. Your attacks with this weapon score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20. When you score a critical hit with this weapon, you immediately cast Black Flame Infusion without expending any resources or otherwise paying its costs.

Bow. As a bonus action, you can make three attacks with the Bow. On a hit, the attack deals additional d6s lightning damage equal to your Constitution modifier. Your attacks with this weapon score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20. When you score a critical hit with this weapon, you immediately cast Black Flame Infusion without expending any resources or otherwise paying its costs.
Lightning Chakra Katana. As an action, you can make an attack with the Lightning Chakra Katana. On a hit, the attack deals additional d10s lightning damage equal to your Constitution modifier.

Kamui Shuriken. As a bonus action, you can manifest and throw a Kamui Shuriken. On a hit, the attack deals additional d8s force damage equal to your Constitution modifier. Whether the attack hits or misses, the point where the target was standing when you made the attack becomes the center of the Kamui Dimension until the end of your turn.

Drill Spear. As an action, you can make an attack with the Drill Spear. On a hit, the attack deals additional d12s force damage equal to your Constitution modifier. If the number rolled for the attack is even, you can cast Chakra Needles without expending a bonus action or any other resources.

Chakra Needles. As a bonus action, you can manifest and launch chakra needles. On a hit, the attack deals additional d4s force damage equal to twice your Constitution modifier. If the number rolled for the attack is even, you can cast Chakra Needles again without expending a bonus action or any other resources.

entries.name: Mangekyō Sharingan Signature
entries: Each Mangekyō Sharingan awakens unique ocular abilities known as Signature Abilities. These powers embody the wielder's unique visual prowess, granting extraordinary control over flames, space, time perception, and the minds of others. Each ability is tied to a specific eye and may carry a terrible cost.

entries.name: Amaterasu
entries: As a action, You expend 15 Sharingan Energy and reduce the Sharingan Durability of the eye used by 5 to unleash the black flames of Amaterasu upon a target you can see. The target is engulfed in black flames and immediately takes fire damage equal to a number of d12s equal to your Constitution modifier.

At the start of each of the target's turns, the target takes fire damage from Amaterasu, and the damage increases by 1d12 after each instance of damage. The black flames do not extinguish themselves, and this effect continues until the target dies, you extinguish the flames, or the target escapes them using an appropriate ability.
A creature can end the effect on itself by severing or removing the body part engulfed in the flames, if physically possible. The DM determines the consequences of doing so.

A creature can also escape the flames by using a teleportation ability, such as {@spell misty step}, to move away from them. The effect ends on that creature, but the flames remain where they were left.
Resistance to fire damage does not extinguish the black flames or end this effect. Immunity to fire damage instead grants resistance to the fire damage dealt by Amaterasu.

entries.name: Kagutsuchi
entries: Kagutsuchi grants you control over the black flames of Amaterasu, allowing you to shape, manipulate, and weaponize them with extraordinary precision. You gain the following abilities:

entries.name: Black Flame Infusion
entries: You can use your bonus action to expend 25 Sharingan Energy and reduce the Sharingan Durability of both your left and right eyes by 5 to unleash the black flames of Amaterasu.

The next time you deal damage to a creature with a weapon, spell, or other feature, you infuse your attack with the black flames. The target takes additional fire damage from Amaterasu as if it had been hit by Amaterasu directly. This damage uses the damage progression described in the Amaterasu feature. The infusion ends after dealing this additional damage.

If black flames created by Amaterasu are already burning within your line of sight, regardless of their source, you can instead use this feature by expending 10 Sharingan Energy and reducing the Sharingan Durability of the eye used by 5.

entries.name: Black Flame Armor
entries: When you are hit by a melee attack, you can use your reaction to expend 25 Sharingan Energy and reduce the Sharingan Durability of both your left and right eyes by 5 to engulf yourself in the black flames of Amaterasu.
The attacker takes fire damage from Amaterasu as if it had been hit by Amaterasu directly. This damage uses the damage progression described in the Amaterasu feature.

If black flames created by Amaterasu are already burning within your line of sight, regardless of their source, you can instead use this feature by expending 10 Sharingan Energy and reducing the Sharingan Durability of the eye used by 5.

entries.name: Control Black Flame
